metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities from Agfa-Gevaert, AGFACOLOR PORTRAIT XPS 160 PROFESSIONAL (Agfa Professional range, Technical Data), AP 70/C-41, Status M. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its dash pattern, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts with the donor's dye spectra and the base density of the agx reference profile 'fujifilm_xtra_400'. Mid-grey where a meter set to EI 160 puts it on the sheet's absolute axis (log H -1.294 lux-seconds). The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. Dye spectra, base density, Hanatos-2025 adaptation parameters, DIR couplers inherited from 'fujifilm_xtra_400', which shares this stock's dye set and process.
